notes.title: Official Release !
notes.content:
[h1]Yahooo ![/h1]
After a bit more than a month of Early Access, we are proud and happy and excited and proud (yes, that makes two "proud") to announce the official release of Antidote !

It's a great day for us, a long working time that takes end (and another that begins, following this stuff), thank you for all that !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37638320/244a5ed4d9f22ee0b335ccd444fb36f4b46b208b.gif[/img]

Thanks to your reviews, we managed to fix many bugs and add the last essential functionnalities (or not so essential but funny ones) to our game. We want to thank all the players which helped us during this time !
But we won't stay here doing nothing. We still are tuned in to enhance our game and fix the bugs you could find.
And if things go well, all the better, enjoy, and talk about the game around you !
Don't hesitate to recommend the game to your friends, coworkers, families, neighboors, people you meet in the street, "do you know Antidote ?", come on, it doesn't cost you and it'll make us happy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37638320/5b0a2f1937189d1fe1d60237637df6fe9c810888.gif[/img]

If you want to contact us, please do via Steam's hub, [url=https://discord.gg/9aF7Tz5]Discord[/url], or e-mail : antidote@teapot-creation.com.

We're fully focused, we answer fast, except in the middle of the night (it depends of the night).


Also we're working on our next game in parallel...

Kisses.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.9.3
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 0.9.3[/h1]
WHAM ! Here is an update with achievements inside (a bunch) and some other modifications (see down there).
We still look for your reviews about functionnalities - and the rest of the game, don't hesitate to tell us !


[h2]Update notes (0.9.3)[/h2]
* Added steam achievements
* Fixed a bug where left hand couldn't be used in the menus
* Upgrade of the movement system (you can now teleport while holding an item in the hand)

* Added Oculus Touch haptic feedback
* Modified the collision system between hands and drawers (avoids hands passing through the drawers without opening them)
* fixed the microscope view for Valve Index
* fixed a bug that modified the mystery codes when using the pause menu
* fixed minor bugs

[h2]What's next ?[/h2]
Final release is always closer...

notes.title: UPDATE 0.9.1
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 0.9.1[/h1]
Here comes the first (big) update for Antidote !
You'll can find mainly the Valve Index & Oculus Rift configuration. The game has been designed with HTC Vive, so manipulations are "classical", the finger dependant animations for Valve Index are not implemented (yet, we'll see that later).
The menu will be greatly modified next, so is the tutorial not up-to-date. I invite you to check the controllers bindings down there :

[h3]HTC Vive :[/h3]
- grab : trigger
- teleport : trackpad up (press+rotation)
- rotation (45°) : trackpad right/left (press)
- crouch/stand : trackpad down
- pause menu : menu button

[h3]Valve Index :[/h3]
- grab : grip
- teleport : thumbstick up (+ rotation)
- rotation (45°) : thumbstick right/left
- crouch/stand : A
- pause menu : B

[h3]Oculus Touch :[/h3]
- grab : grip
- teleport : thumbstick up (+ rotation)
- rotation (45°) : thumbstick right/left
- crouch/stand : A/X
- pause menu : B/Y

Feel free to let us know what changes you'd like to see, i.e. if your binding habits are different !
The tutorial let you choose between 2 teleport types, "simple" or "directionnal". that is to say a standard teleportation or one where you choose your target orientation. In both of cases, joysticks can be used to rotate by 45° left or right. Warning, since the functionality makes the player rotate around the center of the playzone,prefer using it with stationnary playing instead of roomscale.


[h2]Version Notes (0.9.1)[/h2]
* Vive Index configuration (not finger relative animations for now)
* Oculus touch configuration
* Seated configuration (teleport mode choice + auto player height) BUT the menu which can be difficult to reach seated (menu update coming next) 
* Added a skip button for intro (after first watch) 
* Added a skip button for tutorial
* Minor bugs correction

[h2]What's next ?[/h2]
Next to come, a brand new menu, with more options like volume tweaking, moving mode choice... And later will be added (a lot of) achievements and some bonus !

notes.title: Here we are !
notes.content:
[h1]Ta-daaaaaah ![/h1]
That's it ! Today is a great day for all our team because our first VR game Antidote is available !

We're both proud and impatients to get your feedbacks (a little bit stressed too). We need you to finalize that great project !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37638320/e1960b5c859b85d6a6cf24628de99be7c4dcff42.gif[/img]

[h2]Early Access ?[/h2]
This early access should let us refine the game and finish it with the best experience you players can have. For now, Antidote is playable with HTC Vive/Vive Pro. It *should* be playable with Oculus Rift/Rift-S too, but we can't garantee the efficiency and confort, so modifications will be made soon.

[h2]What's next ?[/h2]
Frequent Updates are planned these next weeks, with amongst others the correction of minor bugs, menu and tutorial otpimization, the setup with others VR headsets (included Valve Index), steam achievements... And of course the correction of all bugs you could find as Early Access players. Let us know any ideas, propositions, advices, we stay tuned and will study all of your feedbacks ! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37638320/5770c508678ceb67e15b3fa5286f92c9861677eb.jpg[/img]

[h2]But... Who are you ?[/h2]
A short story about the game : Antidote is a project born in Teapot's studios around 2 years ago, and comes out of 3 brains (rough estimation). Olivier is the thinking guy, which concieved the story bases, most of the mysteries, and the place you'll explore. Ludo is the video master, and gives his esthetic sense, with his multiples cameraman/video editor/director/lighting designer/decorator/bottle opener. And Clément (myself) is there for the technical side, modeling, texturing, programmation, tests and bugs correction.
We love mysteries, escape rooms, and we worked to offer something new, presented, immersive and using computing benefits (next to physical escape rooms). To ensure the replay value of the game, random has been added here and there (mysteries codes, objects storing...), and a nice little paquet of achievements will enjoy the most curious and tenacious of you...

We hope you'll enjoy playing Antidote as much as we enjoyed creating it !

Thanks to you.

TEAPOT's team.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/5iXTLFjce2qcw/giphy.gif[/img]
